text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I'll be able to take a 
decent break soon. Wanting to spend it 
meaningfully, I stared intently at my 
schedule book, when...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! That gesture! That sorrowful 
countenance! It seems you are deeply 
troubled!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nothing escapes the Class Rep's sharp 
eyes! To put it plainly, you're looking 
for a gold-star-worthy day off, aren't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then allow me to invite you to my new 
opera! Excluding intermissions, this 
ultra-mega-masterpiece spans nine and a 
half hours!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, we wake up early! Keep a 
regular schedule, even on days off! Let's 
greet the morning sun with a loud voice!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy☆ What's up? Talking about what to 
do over break?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We've totally gotta hang out! First off, 
squad assembleâ And then~? Karaoke, 
let's goooo!!" his/her tone fits Gal

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, what's that about mole 
crickets?! Are you trying to catch 'em, 
you punk?!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What are we going to catch~? Something 
marvelous!?!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~...? Do you want to catch it too? 
Something... that sparkles...!
choice_data_list:
No, I was just wondering what to do on my 
day off...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaah? What the heck, if that's the case, 
you should've said so earlier~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-chan's recommendation is the ear 
bath! Mark my words, it's gonna be the 
next big trend after foot baths!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha~! Looking for marvelous things~? 
Seek and you shall find what's marvelous☆ 
Over here, over there, everything is 
marrrvelous★

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"How about a little trip? Seeing the 
global world and eating local bento... 
what a precious time!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: First things first, time to get up early!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: La-la~♪ I am~ L'Amou~~r♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's turn up the hype, yoicho-maruuu!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Don't forget to soak your elbows too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm~, bon voyage!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous☆ Marve-loooous★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—On my next day off, I took the plunge and 
tried doing it all, which left me feeling 
wonderfully refreshed.
